purpose: Teach: 共鳴/下院/壊滅/縄文/半減/弾道/受益/書簡

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、業界に共鳴する戦略を打ち出せ
lines.en: We need to put forward a strategy that resonates with the industry.
lines.style: Measured and direct. Sits forward slightly as he lands on each key idea. Authoritative but not harsh—the tone of someone who sees the path and expects the team to follow it.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。米国下院議員との面談を予定しております
lines.en: Yes. We're currently scheduling a meeting with a US congresswoman.
lines.style: Efficient and attentive. Clipped delivery, no extra breath. Professional deference without servility—reporting in, keeping pace with his boss's tempo.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、競合に壊滅されないよう備えろ
lines.en: Make sure we're protected from being devastated by the competition.
lines.style: Sharp attack on the opening. Quiet authority. Each word deliberate. A slight pause before 'devastated'—he means it, and he expects them to hear the weight of it.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。縄文柄を取り入れた商品を企画中です
lines.en: Yes. We're developing a product line incorporating Jomon patterns.
lines.style: Steady and clear. Slight warmth in the delivery—he knows this is a good direction. Lean back slightly, showing confidence in the proposal.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 原価を半減させる方法を模索しろ
lines.en: Find me a way to cut production costs in half.
lines.style: Direct and pressing. A touch of urgency in the tempo. Not aggressive, but this is non-negotiable. Slight emphasis on 'half'—he's testing them.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。新弾道型ロケット技術への投資を検討中です
lines.en: Yes. We're currently exploring investment in new ballistic rocket technology.
lines.style: Measured report. Slight hesitation before 'ballistic'—he knows this is ambitious and he's watching for his boss's reaction. Professional composure maintained throughout.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、受益者ファーストの理念を貫け
lines.en: Keep our core principle front and centre: the beneficiary comes first.
lines.style: Calm but final. Each phrase deliberately spaced. The tone of someone restating what should never be forgotten. A gentle firmness, like setting a stone in place.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。創業者の書簡を社内で展示しております
lines.en: Yes. We're currently displaying the founder's personal letters in the office.
lines.style: Soft, respectful close. Slight reverence in the delivery. Slower pace here—he's showing what matters. A small nod of respect at the end, in the voice.
